run_gsa_results_generation: run the script to generate Grounded SAM detection and segmentation results on input image frames
run_dense_sam_segmentation: run SAM automatic mask generation in dense mode without bounding box prompts on images
run_grounding_dino_detection: run Grounding DINO with SAM to detect and segment objects using text class prompts
run_clip_feature_extraction: run CLIP feature extraction on detected object crops and their corresponding class text labels
run_tag2text_class_detection: run Tag2Text or RAM image tagging to automatically extract object classes for detection
